summary: The loser calls the loss something else: not a loss of theirs, or the city's loss.
realLife: Two losers refuse the word: one says she does not count it a loss, one says the city lost.
sources: Winsome Earle-Sears, Virginia governor race, concession, Nov 4, 2025: https://awpc.cattcenter.iastate.edu/2025/11/10/concession-speech-nov-4-2025
Eric Mitchell, Austin city council runoff loss, June 1997, text in the Austin Chronicle: https://www.austinchronicle.com/news/mitchells-speech-11735820/
Read in full by the local and campaign speeches writer's helper, Nov 24, 2026; every description is a paraphrase.

turns.way: The loser takes the loss as theirs, no reframe.
